material_findings.title: World Bank opened a Small AI development hackathon with a Sep. 26 application deadline and Seoul showcase award
material_findings.summary: The World Bank Group's official Global AI and Digital Summit page now carries the Small AI for Development Hackathon Challenge: applications through Sep. 26, a virtual Oct. 3-4 build weekend, and agriculture, health, or tourism tracks focused on AI that works under constrained connectivity/device conditions. Eligible applicants are ages 18-35 across World Bank member countries, solo or teams up to four. Three category winners receive covered reasonable travel, accommodation and designated event expenses to present in Seoul; the page does not advertise a cash prize. Participants retain ownership subject to a World Bank competition/education/promotion license.
material_findings.recommended_action: Keep as verified opportunity intelligence until participant eligibility/application intent is established. Before active work, preserve the current Hack-Nation registration and technical submission rules, acceptance state, exact deliverables, originality constraints, and any tool/data restrictions. If eligible, a narrow offline/low-connectivity agent or cryptographic verification utility would be a repository-relevant concept without implying authorization to test external systems.
